routing.title: Audio Routing & Virtual Cable
routing.subtitle: Configure virtual audio routing to stream Lir sound effects and your microphone to Discord or games.

routing.echoWarningBody: Primary output and Headphones are the same device. Sent via single channel to prevent duplicate echo. To stream audio to Discord, select CABLE Input as Primary Output.
routing.micPassthroughDesc: Enable this when selecting CABLE Output as your mic in Discord so your own voice passes through. Lir mixes your mic into the virtual cable.
routing.micPassthroughToggle: Stream My Mic into Virtual Cable
routing.antiEchoTitle: Mute Mic While Playing Sounds (Acoustic Anti-Echo)
routing.antiEchoDesc: Prevents sound leaking from your headphones or speakers into your mic from echoing to the other party
routing.guideStep1Body:
• Primary Output: Select CABLE Input.
• Mic Passthrough: Turn ON and select your real mic (not Stereo Mix).
• Anti-Echo: Keep ON.
routing.guideStep2Body:
• Input Device: Select CABLE Output only.
• Echo Cancellation: TURN OFF.
• Noise Suppression (Krisp): TURN OFF.
• Input Sensitivity: Disable automatic and drag slider left.
routing.guideStep3Body:
• Prevent Double Sound: 'Mute Mic While Playing' must be enabled.
• Built-in Limiter: Lir cleans clipping spikes with built-in compression.

guide.title: Usage Guide & Setup
guide.subtitle: Explore Lir's latest audio routing, Makara multi-slicing, Spotify/YouTube import, live subtitle translator, and mobile control.
guide.step1Desc: In Audio Routing, set Primary Output to CABLE Input; select your headphones as Secondary Output and enable Dual Output.
guide.step2Desc: Enable Mic Passthrough and select your physical mic. Keeping Acoustic Anti-Echo on ducks your mic while sound effects play.
guide.step3Desc: Set Discord > Voice & Video > Input Device to CABLE Output. Turn off Echo Cancellation and Krisp noise suppression.
guide.step4Desc: When your game voice chat or Windows default recording device uses 'CABLE Output', triggered sounds play directly into voice chat.
guide.step5Desc: Cut off all active playback immediately using the header Stop button or your global Stop All hotkey in Settings.
guide.modSoundboardSummary: Stream sound cards simultaneously into your virtual microphone and personal headphones with low latency.
guide.modSoundboardP1: Switch between Overlap and Cutoff playback behavior in Settings.
guide.modSoundboardP2: Adjust per-sound volume, loop, favorite pinning, and open any sound directly in Makara with one click.
guide.modSoundboardP3: Built-in compressor/limiter prevents clipping spikes when streaming into Discord or games.
guide.modVoiceSummary: Transform your live voice across 10 DSP presets or record microphone clips directly into the Soundboard.
guide.modVoiceP1: Customize 10 presets including Studio, Anime, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Cave, and Demon with real-time sliders.
guide.modVoiceP2: Enable Self Monitor to hear your processed voice through your headphones.
guide.modVoiceP3: Save live recordings from the Recorder tab straight into Soundboard cards.
guide.modMakaraSummary: Mark multiple waveform regions and export them with zero re-rendering.
guide.modMakaraP1: Drag across empty waveform space to add multiple slices; assign custom labels (Intro, Chorus, Outro, Drop) and individual hotkeys.
guide.modMakaraP2: Add any single slice straight to your library or batch-export checked slices as separate sound cards.
guide.modMakaraP3: Tracks downloaded from Spotify & YouTube Music appear right alongside Soundboard items in the source picker.
guide.modMusicSummary: Connect Spotify playlists or search YouTube Music to fetch full audio straight into your Soundboard.
guide.modMusicP1: Connect via Spotify PKCE Client ID to browse Liked Songs, Playlists, and search tracks.
guide.modMusicP2: Use YouTube Account Device Login (google.com/device) or optional Cookie / cookies.txt import to bypass bot checks.
guide.modMusicP3: Cached tracks stay ready locally so you can play them straight to mic or slice them in Makara.
guide.modHotkeysSummary: Manage system-wide shortcuts, resolve conflicts, and restrict hotkeys to selected games only.
guide.modHotkeysP1: Bind distinct hotkeys for Soundboard items, voice engine toggle, and every voice changer preset.
guide.modHotkeysP2: Spot duplicate key assignments immediately using the Conflicts filter tab.
guide.modHotkeysP3: Configure Settings > App Hotkey Filter so hotkeys only trigger inside allowlisted apps and pause in text inputs.
guide.modTranslatorSummary: Read on-screen subtitles using local device OCR and translate live into an in-game floating overlay.
guide.modTranslatorP1: Share a screen/window, drag a box around the subtitle area, and select the source language.
guide.modTranslatorP2: Electron's click-through sticky overlay floats smoothly above games without stealing mouse focus.
guide.modTranslatorP3: Adjust corner presets or fine-tune X/Y coordinates, dimensions, and font size.
guide.modRemoteSummary: Trigger Soundboard sounds from your phone without alt-tabbing out of your game.
guide.modRemoteP1: Auto-discover on local Wi-Fi/LAN via mDNS, UDP (41234), and WebSocket.
guide.modRemoteP2: Connect from anywhere on the same network or via lirandroid.anticvalley.com.tr Web Relay with Computer Code + PIN.
guide.modRemoteP3: Protect mobile pairing with a 6-digit PIN code.
guide.modAppearanceSummary: Pair Gama, Windows 11, or Windows 10 layouts with custom wallpapers and accent colors.
guide.modAppearanceP1: Choose Gama (3 floating capsule islands), Windows 11, or Windows 10 UI style plus Amoled, Dark, or Light theme.
guide.modAppearanceP2: Upload a custom image or animated GIF wallpaper and tune background blur and island/card transparency.
guide.modAppearanceP3: Broadcast currently playing Soundboard tracks live on your Discord profile via Discord Rich Presence.

spotify.cookieIsMandatoryAnswer: Usually NOT required on a home PC / desktop app. However, it IS required on cloud/shared servers or for tracks triggering YouTube's bot check or age gate.
spotify.cookieExtStep1: Sign in to youtube.com in your browser (ideally using a secondary Google account).
spotify.cookieExtStep2: Install the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension and click Export while on a youtube.com tab.
spotify.cookieExtStep3: Choose the downloaded .txt file using "Choose File (.txt)" on the right or paste its contents.
spotify.cookieDevStep1: With youtube.com open, press F12 (DevTools) → Network tab, then reload the page (F5).
spotify.cookieDevStep2: Click the first youtube.com or /youtubei/v1/ request and scroll to Headers → Request Headers.
spotify.cookieDevStep3: Copy the value of the "cookie:" header (SID=...; HSID=...;) and paste it into the field on the right.
spotify.cookieSecurityTip: Security: A secondary Google account is recommended. Cookies are never stored in browser localStorage or sent back from the server; they remain server-side only.
